reportMetadata.title: Cryptocurrency Trading Platform - Data Retrieval Analysis Report

executiveSummary.overview: This is a comprehensive cryptocurrency trading and signal analysis platform with a multi-provider data architecture. The platform integrates 38+ fallback data sources with intelligent cascading, caching, and rate limiting mechanisms.
executiveSummary.architecturePattern: Singleton services with fallback chains and centralized configuration
executiveSummary.dataMode: Multi-provider with HuggingFace as primary AI/ML data source
keyStrengths: Centralized API configuration with key resolution fallback
Smart rate limiting with token bucket algorithm
keyIssues: Binance service intentionally neutralized (returns dummy data)
Some API keys are hardcoded in configuration files
CoinMarketCap disabled due to quota limitations

routingSystem.description: Express-based routing with centralized data source controller

dataFlow.backend: Express routes → Controllers → Services → External APIs
dataFlow.caching: TTLCache at service level with configurable expiration

primary.name: CoinGecko
primary.notes: Primary source for market data, no API key required

fallbacks.name: Binance Public API
fallbacks.notes: Uses CORS proxy for browser requests

fallbacks.name: CoinMarketCap
fallbacks.notes: DISABLED - Limited quota, use free providers first

Binance.notes: Service intentionally disabled - All methods return dummy data. Real data should flow through DatasourceClient
Binance.reason: Phase 4 neutralization to consolidate data flow

configurationFiles./workspace/config/api.json: Main API configuration with symbols, update intervals, and API settings
configurationFiles./workspace/src/config/CentralizedAPIConf: TypeScript centralized API config with fallback chains
configurationFiles./workspace/src/config/apiSources.ts: API key resolution with fallback mechanisms
configurationFiles./workspace/src/config/apiConfig.ts: Market provider configuration with backoff settings

DataRefreshCoordinator.purpose: Consolidates multiple polling intervals into single coordinated refresh cycle
DataRefreshCoordinator.problem_solved: Previously 6+ components polling every 30s = 12+ API requests/minute for same data
DataRefreshCoordinator.solution: Single refresh cycle that all components subscribe to

DatasourceClient.purpose: Universal data source client - Single source of truth
DatasourceClient.pattern: Singleton with centralized API base URL

MultiProviderMarketDataService.purpose: Multi-source market data with intelligent fallback

FallbackDataManager.purpose: Provides backup data when real APIs are unavailable

critical.title: Binance Service Completely Neutralized
critical.description: BinanceService is intentionally disabled and returns dummy data for all methods
critical.impact: Cannot use Binance as a data source without refactoring
critical.recommendation: Either fully implement or remove the service to reduce code complexity

critical.title: Hardcoded API Keys in Configuration Files
critical.description: Several API keys (CMC, Etherscan, BSCScan, TronScan) are hardcoded in JSON configuration files
critical.impact: Security risk - keys visible in version control
critical.recommendation: Move all API keys to environment variables or a secrets manager

high.title: CoinMarketCap Disabled Due to Quota
high.description: CoinMarketCap is explicitly disabled in configuration due to limited quota
high.impact: Reduces fallback options for market data
high.recommendation: Consider upgrading CMC plan or implementing dynamic quota management

high.title: Mixed Testnet/Mainnet Configuration
high.description: KuCoin has testnet mode enabled by default, which may cause confusion
high.impact: Risk of trading with wrong endpoints
high.recommendation: Make environment more explicit with clear production/development separation

high.title: Inconsistent Error Handling
high.description: Some services throw errors while others return empty arrays on failure
high.recommendation: Standardize error handling across all data services

medium.title: Symbol Mapping Duplication
medium.description: Symbol-to-provider ID mappings are duplicated across multiple services
medium.recommendation: Centralize symbol mappings in a single configuration file

medium.title: Multiple CMC API Keys with Same Quota
medium.description: Two CoinMarketCap keys configured but both likely share the same account quota
medium.recommendation: Use separate CMC accounts for true redundancy

medium.title: No Request Deduplication Across Services
medium.description: Different services may request the same data independently
medium.recommendation: Implement request-level deduplication with shared cache

low.title: Unused CORS Proxies
low.description: 5 CORS proxies configured but usage is not clear
low.recommendation: Implement health checking and automatic proxy rotation

low.title: Cache TTL Inconsistency
low.description: Different cache TTLs defined in different files with no central management

immediate.title: Migrate API Keys to Environment Variables
immediate.description: Move all hardcoded API keys from JSON files to .env
immediate.implementation: Create a .env.example file and update services to use process.env

immediate.title: Enable Request-Level Caching
immediate.description: Implement Redis or in-memory cache at the request coordinator level
immediate.implementation: Use the existing requestCoordinator.ts to add cross-service caching

shortTerm.title: Implement Health-Based Provider Selection
shortTerm.description: Use ResourceMonitorService data to dynamically prioritize healthy providers
shortTerm.implementation: Extend MultiProviderMarketDataService to check provider health before requests

shortTerm.title: Centralize Symbol Mappings
shortTerm.description: Create a single symbol-registry.json with all provider ID mappings
shortTerm.implementation: Extract mappings from services into shared config

shortTerm.title: Add Circuit Breaker Pattern
shortTerm.description: Implement circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures
shortTerm.implementation: Use the circuitBreaker config in providers_config.json as foundation

longTerm.title: Implement WebSocket Aggregation
longTerm.description: Use WebSocket connections for real-time data instead of polling where possible
longTerm.implementation: Extend KuCoin WebSocket support to other providers

longTerm.title: Add Prometheus Metrics
longTerm.description: Expose API call metrics, cache hit rates, and provider health to Prometheus

longTerm.title: Implement GraphQL Gateway
longTerm.description: Create GraphQL layer to optimize frontend data fetching
longTerm.implementation: Add Apollo Server with data loader pattern
